title: Designer Codes from GALA: Compact, Self-Dual, and Rate-1/2 QEC on Reconfigurable Atom Arrays
summary: Achieving useful fault-tolerant applications requires co-designing the quantum error-correcting code for footprint, logical instruction set, and hardware compatibility simultaneously. Recent breakthroughs in ultra-high-rate codes have the potential to reduce footprint of large scale quantum applications but their practical utility is limited without an addressable logical instruction set and efficient implementation on near term hardware.
